items.evidence: The prospectively frozen CIGL-ATR-01 defines 1H primary and 4H robustness and the executed runner evaluates both timeframes in the same 2022-2023 Discovery pass. Recasting the already-observed 4H robustness slice as a new prospective TFG attack would be outcome-exposed duplication.

The prospectively frozen CIGL-OBV-01 defines 1H primary and 4H robustness and the successful Discovery run already opened the 4H robustness outcome. A new TFG 4H experiment would not be outcome-blind.
